motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Instant tactile response for switches and mode selection.

components.name: Mode Card
components.description: Card-based site mode selector item with icon, title, tag, and radio indicator.
components.css: .ds-mode-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px 1fr auto; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1.5px solid #38bdf8; background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12); color: #f8fafc; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-mode-icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 6px; background: #38bdf8; color: #090d16; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-mode-icon svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-mode-title { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-mode-tag { font-size: 9.5px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2); color: #38bdf8; } .ds-mode-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-mode-radio { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #38bdf8; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-top: 3px; } .ds-mode-radio::after { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #38bdf8; }

components.name: Custom Switch
components.description: Accessible sliding toggle switch for global and per-site state.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 22px; display: inline-flex; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; z-index: 1; } .ds-switch-slider { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: #38bdf8; border-radius: 999px; transition: background 140ms ease; } .ds-switch-slider::before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 16px; height: 16px; right: 3px; top: 3px; background-color: #090d16; border-radius: 50%; }

narrative.overview: NativeScroll operates as a calibrated flight recorder and control cockpit for web scrolling physics. Designed for zero-latency comprehension and immediate physical control.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-latency restraint without decorative gradients or glassmorphism
Deep obsidian and crisp light foundations tuned to native OS themes
Calibrated vector iconography across toolbar assets and in-app controls
Card-based site mode cockpit with dedicated tactile radios

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric cobalt/cyan is reserved exclusively for interactive focus, selection, and active switches.

rules.name: The Declare Elevation Once Rule
rules.body: Never combine an aggressive border with a wide fuzzy shadow. A card declares elevation through hairline boundary and ground contrast alone.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: All numeric data, versions, and performance indicators use tabular numerals to eliminate layout shift.

dos: Do maintain strict WCAG AAA / AA contrast ratios across all variations
Do use authored vector SVG icons instead of emojis
Do preserve exact-host matching in exclusions
donts: Don't use gradient text or decorative background blur filters
Don't use colored left/right borders on cards as accent decorations
Don't introduce external network calls or tracking scripts
